purpose: Make five implicit return links and level-versus-contraction signs explicit in the human checkpoint. Original raw constructions remain unchanged. These are added conditional assumptions, not measured causal effects or novelty verdicts.

entries.display_loop: Repeated assisted style → audience expectations → acquisitions → future proposal distribution → repeated style; future proposals → articulated self-reasons → willingness to continue that style → repeated style.
entries.added_assumption: Proposal-conditioned reasons increase continued production of that style; audience investment makes desired departures more costly. Either link can fail, and genuine chosen tradition can benefit.

entries.display_loop: Routine translation use → teaching of the codified explanation → familiarity with that codification → institutional recognition → default translation reliance → routine translation use. Reliance separately reduces live practice of omitted disagreement forms.
entries.added_assumption: Default use includes repeated teaching, and familiarity influences recognition. If recognition is independent of taught familiarity, the self-validation return is absent.

entries.display_loop: Routine automation volume → price pressure on apprenticeship organizations → loss of a prerequisite learning band → fewer new independent experts → scarcer standby judgment → greater routine automation attractiveness → routine automation volume.
entries.added_assumption: Automation attractiveness changes actual routine volume, and routine margins contribute to independent training. Funded external ladders or transferable tutoring can break the cycle.

entries.display_loop: Successful routine closure reduces complaint arrivals. Complaint arrivals increase review funding; funding increases independent staff; staff increases supported appeals; supported appeals expose missed errors and reduce measured reliability; measured reliability increases reliance on routine closure. Longer pre-admission ancestry requirements separately reduce supported appeals.
entries.added_assumption: Measured reliability changes reliance and funding follows recorded complaints. The raw shorthand 'complaint-linked funding → staff (−)' describes contraction, not a negative derivative of staff with respect to funding; the displayed loop corrects that ambiguity without changing the raw record.

entries.display_loop: Provider change → informative interpretation disagreement → user-reviewed portable constraints → lower transfer error → feasible switching → further provider changes. Selective deletion of obsolete interpretations reduces reconciliation burden.
entries.added_assumption: Users exercise at least some newly feasible switches and constraints remain reusable. Feasibility alone does not entail repeated switching or useful learning.
